_integration_point: MOL-7974 authors the real coding doctrine and REPLACES the `predicates` array below. Activate a doctrine by copying this file to `guardrail-predicates.json` next to guardrail-predicates-portable.sh (the packaging step does this automatically), or by pointing MOLLOW_PORTABLE_PREDICATES_FILE at it.
_sanitizer_contract: MOL-2182: NO monorepo paths, NO /workspaces/ assumptions, NO Mollow-internal repo slugs/identifiers. Every rule must be portable to any customer repo. check_portable_predicates_sanitized() (in guardrail-predicates-portable.sh) enforces this and is run by the test suite and the packaging step.

_schema.applies_to: array of tool names: Bash | Write | Edit | MultiEdit
_schema.target: which field to match: command | file_path | content
_schema.pattern: an Oniguruma regular expression (jq test/2), matched against the target text
_schema.flags: optional jq regex flags, e.g. "i" for case-insensitive
_schema.message: short advisory shown to the user
_schema.fix: how to satisfy the doctrine instead
_schema._note: All predicates are WARN-ONLY (advisory); the loader always emits warn severity.

predicates.fix: Prefer 'git push --force-with-lease' so you don't clobber a teammate's commits.
Let the pre-commit / pre-push checks run; skip them only deliberately.
Capture the follow-up in your issue tracker rather than leaving a bare marker in the code.
